subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:380 routes tree opens through run(...).then(show), bypassing the generation checks in open(). At :110, show's default collection argument is evaluated when the reply arrives, so it does not capture the initiating collection either. Independently reproduced: defer the tree's B reply, let the selected-tab loads show B and then A, then release the old tree reply. A remains selected but its editor, Send and response pane disappear, with no failure or recovery control. Acceptance: bind every document-producing callback to its initiating collection lifetime and applicable selection/load generation; obsolete replies cannot replace the current document. Add deferred tree-click and collection-change regressions while preserving the new-draft/stale-snapshot behavior.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:126 invalidates load generations on collection changes without clearing loading.current; :162 then skips reopening a selected request whose ID matches that obsolete load. Independently reproduced: hold A's initial observation, close its collection, reopen the same collection with A selected, then settle the old observation. Only one openRequest was dispatched; the old result is discarded and the reopened editor stays blank without an alert or Try again. Acceptance: retire obsolete loading markers at collection boundaries and initiate one fresh load on reopening; late results from the previous lifetime must remain ignored. Cover close/reopen while the initial load is pending.

R3 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/request-tree.tsx:224 receives only a boolean from ApiClient's onCreate at api-client.tsx:381, leaving creation failures in the background page alert. v2-shell.tsx:404 makes that page inert and aria-hidden while the New request/New folder dialog is open. Independently reproduced a duplicate-path refusal: the dialog remains open with the entered path, contains zero alerts, and the reason appears only behind it. Acceptance: expose refused and undelivered creation results accessibly inside the active dialog, retaining entered work and focus without automatic retries. Add request and folder failure regressions.
